name: Chameleon
body:
Discipline psychometabolism; Level cryptic 1, egoist 2, gifted blade 1, marskman 1, psychic warrior 1, sighted seeker 1

MANIFESTING

Display Olfactory
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Power Points cryptic 1, egoist 3, gifted blade 1, marksman 1, psychic warrior 1

DESCRIPTION

Your skin and equipment take on the color and texture of nearby objects, including floors and walls. You receive a +10 enhancement bonus on Stealth checks.

Augment For every two additional power points spent, the enhancement bonus on Stealth checks increases by 1.
